data.body:
Plan review round 2 BLOCKed with one finding, and it is correct.

Finding (criterion E4): the Approach's hlc.py bullet named only the override block :42-47 and the physical_now docstring :39-41, but REBAR_HLC_NOW appears a THIRD time in the MODULE docstring at hlc.py:19 -- 'REBAR_HLC_NOW injects skewed test time.' AC1's src-wide grep covers all three, so an implementer following the Approach literally would have failed AC1 at the end.

Verified against origin/main e21f3240cd0 before accepting: git grep -n REBAR_HLC_NOW -- src/rebar/_store/hlc.py returns exactly :19, :39, :42. The finding is right.

Worth recording precisely: AC1's own pre-state already listed the hits as 'hlc.py:19,39,42', so the AC was correct and only the Approach was incomplete -- an internal conflict between the two sections, which is exactly what E4 detects. The implementation in .rebar/worktrees/impl-b939 had already removed all three (the src-wide grep is empty there), so this is a plan-text defect, not an implementation one.

Fixed: the hlc.py bullet now reads 'delete ALL THREE REBAR_HLC_NOW mentions AC1's grep covers: the override block :42-47, the physical_now docstring (:39-41), and the MODULE docstring sentence at :19'. The Context line now names :19 and :39 too. Also corrected in the same edit: the bullet previously said 'import os goes if unused' -- it is NOT unused, _max_event_prefix still needs it, so it stays.

Length stayed under the 8000 budget (7995) by collapsing a duplicated restatement of the test_hlc.py:91 inversion and compressing the subprocess line list.

Advisory, not acted on: P6 ac-quality flagged 3 criterion lines bundling deliverables with 'and'. Splitting them would add length the budget cannot absorb, and the clauses are each independently checkable as written.

Review round 3 is running.
